name: zinput_bindgroup_list_at_exit_destructor
description: zInput::BindGroupListAtExitDestructor releases the global bind-group vector storage and clears begin/end/cap.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput bootstrap/vector pass.
Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja exposes compiler scratch locals around the static destructor wrapper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x429f50 shows operator delete on g_zInput_BindGroupInfoList.begin followed by zeroing begin, end, and cap.
The dependency frontier has only the accepted operator delete provider thunk.

The native smoke allocates vector storage with operator new, calls the destructor wrapper, verifies the global vector pointers are cleared, and spawns a child process that exits cleanly through the registered atexit destructor with live vector storage.
